title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart – Household Internet Access by Region
prompt: The bar chart below shows the percentage of households with internet access in four regions (Northland, Southland, Eastland, Westland) in 2005, 2015, and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类雅思写作 Task 1 练习。所有场景与数据均为模拟，非官方雅思试卷。请根据柱状图描述主要特征并进行比较，不要表达个人观点或解释原因。建议先观察整体趋势（哪些地区增长最快、哪些地区始终领先或落后），再选取关键数据点进行对比。注意使用恰当的时态（过去时、现在完成时）和比较结构。字数不少于150词。
